response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount > 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY avg_pressratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Scans with a NULL phasefactor form their own group, since SQL GROUP BY keeps NULL keys together; the request does not say to drop them.
Rows with a NULL pressratio are skipped by AVG, and a group whose pressratio values are all NULL returns NULL and sorts last. Empty strings are not treated as missing.
Ties in avg_pressratio are broken arbitrarily, so the set of 10 rows can vary at a tie on the cutoff. The request gives no tiebreaker.
